name: Spawn Researcher on New Task
description: When the initial general agent completes successfully, spawn a researcher. The researcher receives the parent loop id as a reference and uses read_loop_result to fetch the original question body on demand. Rules carry references, not payloads — see ADR-028.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.research
on_enter.prompt: Research a question that was submitted to the parent agent loop $entity.id. Call read_loop_result with that loop id to fetch the question body, then investigate using graph_query and web_search. When you have a complete answer, submit plain-text findings.
